title: Ditero | Self-hosted tasks for small groups
description: A free, self-hosted task app for households and small groups. Current alpha available.
heading: A place for the everyday work.
intro: Shopping lists, chores, projects and habits, together on your own server. Ditero is free and open source.
everyday: Keep tasks, shopping lists, checklists and projects together. Recurring tasks and habits help with the work that comes around again.
local: The browser keeps a local copy of synced work and reconnects when the server is available. Initial sign-in and file uploads need a connection.
files: Attachments are encrypted on the client before upload. The server stores ciphertext and still sees operational metadata, including sizes and parent records.
requirements: One person runs the server. Everyone connects through a browser or a client. Docker Compose runs Ditero, PostgreSQL 18 and the Zero sync service together.
clients: Signed Android downloads and experimental Linux x64, Windows x64 and macOS ARM64 installers connect to your Ditero server. Native clients require trusted HTTPS. There is no iOS release.
alpha: The published release is v0.0.1-alpha.2. Breaking changes are expected. Windows builds are unsigned; macOS uses ad-hoc signatures. Native platform coverage, notifications and updates have remaining limits. Back up the database and attachments together.
license: Free and open source under MIT.
requirementsAdvanced: External PostgreSQL needs logical replication, direct Zero connections and separate runtime and migration roles. Keep your original secrets and persistent storage across upgrades.
previewAlt: Ditero dashboard with task lists and routines using sample household data.
previewCaption: Current development preview with sample household data.
